# ERRATA-CRAFT — the craft-knowledge view

**Generated by `tools/errata-store.py render`. Do not hand-edit.**

This is the readable half of the store behind [`ERRATA.md`](ERRATA.md). `ERRATA.md` stays append-only and is never edited; this view is regenerated from `record/errata.jsonl` and can be deleted and rebuilt at any time. Measurement findings are **pinned** — the freeze cites them by date and compaction never moves them. Craft findings carry a prototype confidence, a usage count, and an expiry.

## Compaction

`tools/errata-store.py compact --dry-run` shows what a compaction would merge or expire. Nothing pinned is ever touched; merged and expired bodies move to `record/archive/`, and `restore <id>` (or `rollback --to <seq>`) puts them back. The live mutation log is sealed to `record/archive/` past 500 events, with a SHA-256 digest recorded in the next snapshot, so the audit trail is complete without growing without bound.
